description: The channels of the network of the time of Gilgamesh (Fig. 6 A of Jotheri et al. 2018, in the finer drawing of its Fig. 4) not yet told by the survey canals (tools/digitize_channel_network.py): metres east (x) and south (z) of Uruk's tell. 'earlier' is panel B (a later interval), 'later' the channels of Fig. 4 that panel A lacks; neither is laid.
